SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
Special Branch S. L. Station,
REPORT
Date September 19 32.
(in full) Breach of Municipal Regulations
in re "Loh Sik Kyi", S. E.
Made by.................... Forwarded by.................... C.D.I. Prince.

Sir,
On September 17, 1932, I called the attention of Loh Sik
Kyi (陸爵) attached to Special Branch S. L, to the complaint
against him as quoted in the attached report made by S.I. J. Powell,
Vigus Station, regarding his noncompliance with instructions
regarding a sunshade at his premises No. 415 Sinez Road. . Loh
Sik Kyi informed me that the sunshade in question had not been
used since the first complaint regarding it was made, and he
could not understand what further was required. I then
pointed out to him that the supports of the sunshade constituted
an obstruction, and advised him to comply with the requirements
of the regulations regarding sunshades as soon as possible. Now
he informs me that he has had the structure removed altogether.

C. D. I.
O/C Special Branch.

C. D. I. Prince;
Please tell Mr Loh
to call personally on S. O. "B",
and give him the above
explanations. In the first
instance, Mr Loh should have
ascertained what was expected from
him and acted accordingly.
I have instructed Mr Loh
to comply as above.
19:9:32

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号............
特别处 S. L. 分局，
报告
日期 1932年9月19日。
（全称） 关于“Loh Sik Kyi”，S. E. 违反市政规章事宜
由.................... 呈报 经.................... C.D.I. Prince 转呈。

先生，
1932年9月17日，我提请附属于特别处 S. L. 的 Loh Sik Kyi（陸爵）注意针对他的投诉，该投诉引自威格斯分局警司 J. Powell 所提交的附件报告，内容涉及其未遵守关于新闸路415号住所遮阳篷的指示。Loh Sik Kyi 告知我，自首次收到关于该遮阳篷的投诉以来，该遮阳篷一直未使用，他不明白还需要做什么。随后我向他指出，遮阳篷的支架构成了障碍物，并建议他尽快遵守有关遮阳篷的规章要求。现在他通知我，他已将整个结构拆除。

C. D. I.
特别处处长。

C. D. I. Prince；
请告诉 Loh 先生
亲自前往“B”区警司处，
并向其作出上述
解释。起初，Loh 先生本应
查明对他有何要求
并据此行事。
我已指示 Loh 先生
按上述要求办理。
1932年9月19日

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Moore.

Sir,
With reference to the attached summons application and
memorandum from the Divisional Officer "B" Division, I have to
state that Clerk Loh Sin-kyin is at present absent from Shanghai
on leave.
The instructions of Divisional Officer "B" Division
have however been conveyed to the wife of the Clerk Loh, who has
promised to rectify matters immediately.

Moore
